summary: Iter13: validated per-merchant order state machine on multi-store orders. All 8 backend pytests pass (test_multi_merchant_orders.py). Frontend E2E confirmed: customer OrderTracking hides global stepper & renders multi-store-breakdown with one MiniStepper per store updating independently; MerchantOrders dashboard buckets order by my_state and shows merchant_subtotal (₹599) not global total (₹1,797); merchant A could accept + hand-off independently while B remained pending (order moved to onway bucket for A only); StickyCart pill hidden on /cart and /checkout (mobile viewport) and visible on home.

issues: Console warning: empty string passed to img src attribute (pre-existing, unrelated to this iteration)

critical_code_review_comments: StickyCart guard logic (StickyCart.jsx:14) correctly uses pathname.startsWith() — safe for nested routes like /cart/anything.
OrderTracking.jsx:329 falls back to deriving store breakdown from items if backend store_breakdown missing — defensive and good.
MerchantOrders.jsx consistently uses (o.merchant_subtotal ?? o.total) across buckets — good fallback for single-store legacy orders.
